program.name: Evening Strength
program.subject: Calm strength
program.blurb: A calm evening session: a short Pilates start, one kettlebell lifted steadily, then yin.
program.about: A calm session for the evening with one kettlebell. A short Pilates series wakes the core, then steady kettlebell strength, lower body one day and upper body the next, then long yin holds to wind down before bed. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down. Nothing fast and nothing loud.
program.split: Bell lower & yin / bell upper & yin
